tldr: Venus through the 8th house brings focus to shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement.
body: Venus transiting the 8th house softens shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports shared money and deep trust: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or control, avoidance, or crisis attachment.
advice: Receive and refine in the 8th house deliberately. Work with shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
